verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
"Honour your father and mother." This is the first command with a promise:
"so that it may go well with you, and you may live a long life on the earth."
Fathers, do not make your children angry. Instead, bring them up with the training and teaching of the Lord.
Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear, and with an honest heart, just as you would obey Christ.
Do not obey them only when they are watching, to win their favour. Obey them as slaves of Christ, doing what God wants from your heart.
Serve them gladly, as if you were serving the Lord, not people.
You know that the Lord will reward each person for whatever good he does, whether he is a slave or free.
Masters, treat your slaves in the same way. Do not threaten them. You know that both they and you have the same Master in heaven, and he treats everyone the same.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
Put on the full armour of God, so that you can stand against the devil's tricks.
Our fight is not against human beings. It is against the rulers, the authorities, the powers of this dark world, and the evil spiritual forces in the heavenly places.
So put on the full armour of God. Then when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground. And after you have done everything, you will still be standing.
So stand firm. Wear the belt of truth around your waist, and the breastplate of being right with God.
For shoes, put on the readiness that comes from the Good News of peace.
Above all, take up the shield of faith. With it you can put out all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
Take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
Pray in the Spirit at all times, with all kinds of prayers and requests. Stay alert, and keep on praying for all God's people.
Pray for me too. Pray that God will give me the right words when I speak, so that I can boldly make known the secret of the Good News.
I am an ambassador for it, in chains. Pray that I will speak about it boldly, as I should.
Tychicus, our dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you all my news, so that you know how I am.
I am sending him to you for this very reason, so that you know how we are, and so that he can encourage you.
Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with a love that never dies. Amen.
